utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Hey Uli — I can help with the repair drive. What’s the next thing you need sorted?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Leo. I just need a hand sorting the donations and seeing what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sure — I can help sort the donations first, then we can check what still needs fixing.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I’d like to know the pickup time and where everything’s going first.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Right — can you confirm the pickup time and the drop-off location?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Sure — what time is the pickup, and where should it be dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh—right, the repair drive. I’m a bit behind; what changed?

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Ah, not much changed that I can recall—just the usual repairs, I think. If you want, I can check what’s been posted and tell you for sure.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Yeah, could you check and let me know? I must’ve missed the latest posts.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m going to mention the repair drive to a few neighbors and see who can help out.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: That’s a good idea — I can ask around while I’m out running errands too.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Thanks, Ira — I’ll do the same and let you know who’s interested.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Sorry I’m late — how’s the repair drive going?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: No worries — it’s going well. I’ve got a few tools set aside if you need them.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Gus — that helps a lot. I’m here now, so just point me where you need me.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good—let’s keep it simple. What time’s the repair drive, and what should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Let’s do Saturday at 10 in the community lot—just bring gloves if you’ve got them, and maybe a screwdriver set if you can.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Saturday at 10 in the community lot works for me. I’ll bring gloves and my screwdriver set.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Sam, are we still on for the repair drive today?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Yes, I’m still on for it. I’ll be there and ready to help.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Great — what time should I tell everyone to meet?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: I’m happy to help with the repair drive—want me to spread the word or help organize anything?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Could you help spread the word? I’m keeping the repair drive centered at the community hall this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Absolutely — I’ll spread the word and keep it centered on the community hall this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: I’m in—what repairs do you want me to help with for the drive?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Thank you, Mara — I’d love your help with porch railings, leaky faucets, and a few small electrical fixes if you’re comfortable with those. We’re keeping it simple and neighbor-friendly.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sounds good — I can help with the porch railings and faucets, and I’ll stick to the small electrical fixes I’m comfortable with.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I can help keep track of what we still need for the repair drive. Tell me what’s been collected so far, and I’ll note the rest.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Thanks, Cleo — I haven’t sorted the list yet, but I’ll tell you what’s been collected as soon as I check.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sounds good, Bo — just let me know when you’ve checked, and I’ll keep track of the rest.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, the repair drive? I heard it’s coming together nicely—folks are dropping off tools and parts all morning.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: That’s good to hear. I’ll stop by later and see if they need anything else.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Great idea—I'm sure they’d appreciate the extra help. I’ll let you know if I hear they need anything specific.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: I’d like to double-check the repair drive details before I say yes—what time is it, and what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: It starts at 10 a.m., and if you can, please bring a screwdriver and a flashlight.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Got it—10 a.m., with a screwdriver and a flashlight. I’ll bring those and be there.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Sounds good — what do you need me to bring?

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Just a screwdriver set and maybe some duct tape if you’ve got it.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Got it — I’ll bring a screwdriver set and some duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: I’m planning to help out with the repair drive, and I’ll let folks know what’s needed as I hear it.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: That’s great, Vik — I can help spread the word too if you want.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: That’d be really helpful, Jules. I’ll keep you posted on what they still need so we can spread it around.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, the repair drive? Right, I’m still trying to catch up on that—what’s changed?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Not much yet, really — I just wanted to check in and see if you needed anything. I can help, quietly, if that would make it easier.

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Thanks, Uli — I might take you up on that if I spot what I’m missing. Right now I’m just trying to get oriented, so a quiet heads-up would help.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I heard the repair drive is starting soon—what do you need a hand with?

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: I can lend a few tools and help out where I can—just tell me what needs fixing first.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Thanks, Gus—that’d help a lot. I’ll ask around and see what needs fixing first, then I’ll let you know.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Absolutely — I’ll get the repair drive organized and keep everyone in the loop. Let’s make sure we’ve got the list of needed fixes and a good time for volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: I can help keep the location list straight and note which homes need what. Send me the fixes and I’ll organize them by address.

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Perfect, Opal — I’ll gather the fixes and send you a clean list by address. Thanks for helping keep this all straight.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: I’m happy to help, but I want to make sure the repair drive is organized—who’s handling the supplies and where should everything be dropped off?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great question — I’m handling the supply list, and drop-offs should go to the community center by the front entrance. I’ll send around a quick note so everyone’s on the same page.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Thanks, that helps — I’ll watch for the note and plan to bring things to the front entrance.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Just to confirm, this repair drive is still happening, right?

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Yes, it’s still happening — I just want to double-check the details before we go ahead.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Got it — what details still need double-checking?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: I’m happy to help, Dane — just tell me the plan for the repair drive, and I’ll stick to it.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Thanks, Eli — I’ll join late, but I’ll help where you need me. Just point me to the first task when I arrive.

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Sounds good, Dane — when you arrive, start with the tool table and I’ll have the next task lined up for you.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: I heard there’s a repair drive coming up — do you know what they still need?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: I’ve seen they still need tape, batteries, and a few hand tools. I can check the list again and let you know if anything else comes up.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Thanks, that’d be great — I’m still piecing it together from the word of mouth. If you see the list, let me know what’s most needed.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, right—the repair drive. I meant to help out, but I’m a bit foggy on the details; can you remind me what still needs doing?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Sure — we still need a few hands to sort donations, label parts, and help people match up with the right tools. If you can swing by, I’ll put you on the sign-in list.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Yeah, I can swing by and help with that — sorting donations and labeling parts sounds manageable. Put me on the sign-in list, and I’ll do my best to stay on task.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule, but I’ll need the details for the repair drive first.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Thanks, Faye — I’ll send the repair drive details over now so you can work around the school schedule.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, send them when you can and I’ll fit things around pickup and drop-off times.
